1Jn.5.20.bsb: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
1Jn.5.20.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

1Jn.5.11.bsb: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
1Jn.5.11.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

1Jn.1.8.bsb: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
1Jn.1.8.kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

1Jn.5.19.bsb: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
1Jn.5.19.kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

1Jn.3.5.bsb: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.
1Jn.3.5.kjv: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

1Jn.1.1.bsb: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
1Jn.1.1.kjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

1Jn.1.2.bsb: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
1Jn.1.2.kjv: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

1Jn.4.3.bsb: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
1Jn.4.3.kjv: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

1Jn.4.7.bsb: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
1Jn.4.7.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

1Jn.4.21.bsb: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
1Jn.4.21.kjv: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

1Jn.3.23.bsb: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
1Jn.3.23.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

1Jn.3.18.bsb: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
1Jn.3.18.kjv: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

1Jn.5.1.bsb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
1Jn.5.1.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

1Jn.4.11.bsb: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
1Jn.4.11.kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

1Jn.2.10.bsb: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
1Jn.2.10.kjv: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

1Jn.3.14.bsb: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.
1Jn.3.14.kjv: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

1Jn.2.9.bsb: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
1Jn.2.9.kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

1Jn.2.11.bsb: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
1Jn.2.11.kjv: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

1Jn.4.20.bsb: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
1Jn.4.20.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

1Jn.3.10.bsb: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
1Jn.3.10.kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

1Jn.5.14.bsb: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
1Jn.5.14.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

1Jn.3.22.bsb: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
1Jn.3.22.kjv: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

1Jn.5.15.bsb: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
1Jn.5.15.kjv: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

1Jn.5.16.bsb: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
1Jn.5.16.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

1Jn.4.1.bsb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
1Jn.4.1.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

1Jn.4.2.bsb: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
1Jn.4.2.kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

1Jn.1.7.bsb: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
1Jn.1.7.kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

1Jn.3.1.bsb: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
1Jn.3.1.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

1Jn.3.2.bsb: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
1Jn.3.2.kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

1Jn.4.4.bsb: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
1Jn.4.4.kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

1Jn.3.17.bsb: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
1Jn.3.17.kjv: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

1Jn.1.6.bsb: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
1Jn.1.6.kjv: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

1Jn.2.4.bsb: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
1Jn.2.4.kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

1Jn.3.6.bsb: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.
1Jn.3.6.kjv: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

1Jn.4.8.bsb: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
1Jn.4.8.kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

1Jn.2.12.bsb: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.
1Jn.2.12.kjv: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

1Jn.2.13.bsb: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.
1Jn.2.13.kjv: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

1Jn.5.12.bsb: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
1Jn.5.12.kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

1Jn.1.10.bsb: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
1Jn.1.10.kjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

1Jn.2.16.bsb: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
1Jn.2.16.kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

1Jn.3.21.bsb: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
1Jn.3.21.kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

1Jn.5.4.bsb: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
1Jn.5.4.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

1Jn.4.16.bsb: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
1Jn.4.16.kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

1Jn.5.5.bsb: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
1Jn.5.5.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

1Jn.5.10.bsb: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
1Jn.5.10.kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

1Jn.5.13.bsb: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
1Jn.5.13.kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

1Jn.1.9.bsb: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
1Jn.1.9.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

1Jn.2.1.bsb: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
1Jn.2.1.kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

1Jn.2.15.bsb: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
1Jn.2.15.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

1Jn.2.22.bsb: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
1Jn.2.22.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

1Jn.2.23.bsb: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well.
1Jn.2.23.kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

1Jn.2.24.bsb: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
1Jn.2.24.kjv: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

1Jn.4.14.bsb: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
1Jn.4.14.kjv: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

1Jn.1.3.bsb: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
1Jn.1.3.kjv: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

1Jn.3.19.bsb: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:
1Jn.3.19.kjv: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

1Jn.4.17.bsb: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
1Jn.4.17.kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

1Jn.4.18.bsb: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
1Jn.4.18.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

1Jn.1.5.bsb: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
1Jn.1.5.kjv: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

1Jn.2.20.bsb: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
1Jn.2.20.kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

1Jn.4.12.bsb: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
1Jn.4.12.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

1Jn.3.20.bsb: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
1Jn.3.20.kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

1Jn.4.9.bsb: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
1Jn.4.9.kjv: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

1Jn.4.10.bsb: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
1Jn.4.10.kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

1Jn.4.13.bsb: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
1Jn.4.13.kjv: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

1Jn.4.15.bsb: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
1Jn.4.15.kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

1Jn.4.19.bsb: We love because He first loved us.
1Jn.4.19.kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.

1Jn.3.24.bsb: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
1Jn.3.24.kjv: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

1Jn.5.6.bsb: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
1Jn.5.6.kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

1Jn.5.7.bsb: For there are three that testify:
1Jn.5.7.kjv: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

1Jn.5.8.bsb: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.
1Jn.5.8.kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

1Jn.5.21.bsb: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
1Jn.5.21.kjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

1Jn.3.3.bsb: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
1Jn.3.3.kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

1Jn.2.17.bsb: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
1Jn.2.17.kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

1Jn.2.25.bsb: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
1Jn.2.25.kjv: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

1Jn.3.13.bsb: So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
1Jn.3.13.kjv: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

1Jn.3.15.bsb: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
1Jn.3.15.kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

1Jn.2.18.bsb: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.
1Jn.2.18.kjv: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

1Jn.2.3.bsb: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
1Jn.2.3.kjv: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

1Jn.2.5.bsb: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
1Jn.2.5.kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

1Jn.2.6.bsb: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.
1Jn.2.6.kjv: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

1Jn.2.14.bsb: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
1Jn.2.14.kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

1Jn.3.7.bsb: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
1Jn.3.7.kjv: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

1Jn.3.9.bsb: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
1Jn.3.9.kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

1Jn.2.28.bsb: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
1Jn.2.28.kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

1Jn.5.17.bsb: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
1Jn.5.17.kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

1Jn.3.4.bsb: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
1Jn.3.4.kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

1Jn.3.8.bsb: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
1Jn.3.8.kjv: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

1Jn.2.2.bsb: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
1Jn.2.2.kjv: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

1Jn.1.4.bsb: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.
1Jn.1.4.kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

1Jn.2.7.bsb: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
1Jn.2.7.kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

1Jn.2.8.bsb: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
1Jn.2.8.kjv: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

1Jn.2.21.bsb: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
1Jn.2.21.kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

1Jn.3.16.bsb: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
1Jn.3.16.kjv: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

1Jn.2.27.bsb: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
1Jn.2.27.kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
